Settings

Launch
Enter this before choosing a game file. Keys stay in memory.
Supports .cxi, .cia, .3dsx, .app and .ncch (5 GiB max). Encrypted titles may need a seed under Decryption keys.
Firmware & DSP HLE
Import a real DSP1 firmware dump or use a zero-byte placeholder for Citra-style HLE checks. The empty file is not actual firmware or a guarantee of game audio.

Decryption keys & game seeds
Accepts Azahar/Citra aes_keys.txt or TITLE_ID = TITLE_KEY entries.
Embedded AES entries load automatically.
Required for some seed-encrypted titles, including the original Terraria CIA. A decrypted CXI does not need it.

Optional 3DS system data archives
Import a decrypted Mii-data CFA or IVFC RomFS before loading a game.
Embedded Mii archive ready by default.
The emulator defaults to a synthetic NGWord compatibility filesystem with an empty four-byte version and no word list. Import your own decrypted CFA to replace it. The fallback is NOT real system data; a guest reload is required.
Synthetic NGWord HLE enabled by default: root and /version.dat only. Reload after changing this setting.
Export a private HTML

Single-file portable build

Bundle your locally imported firmware with the emulator. Optional private keys can be included when explicitly selected.

Firmware import is optional.
Any embedded AES entries can be read by opening the HTML source. Never share private builds.
Editing embedded title keys
The HTML contains an editable embedded-title-keys slot for advanced users. Only use keys from software and hardware you own.
